name: Play! Pokémon Prize Pack Series Four

releases.name: Play! Pokémon Prize Pack Series Four

description.text:
Play! Pokémon Prize Packs are six-card packs that Pokémon sends to Play! Pokémon stores to hand out at in-store events such as Leagues, League Challenges and League Cups; stores with more active events get more packs. Every card is a reprint that keeps its original set number and is marked with the Play! Pokémon logo.

Series Four, available from 14 February 2024, holds 86 cards from Lost Origin through Obsidian Flames, plus SVE basic Energy, all legal in the Standard format when it came out; Charizard ex, Pidgeot ex and Iono were among the cards Pokémon named. Its foil cards are cosmos holo, except Pokémon V, VMAX, VSTAR and ex, which keep their usual foil.
